runtime.command_template: python tools/lah_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game lah_112 --rom-path <read-only-rom-root> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/data-east/lah-112-<run>.json --boot-wait 8 --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. No keyboard handling: every stimulus is a direct public switch write (the Black Advance button at -7, the Green input at -6, then playfield and cabinet addresses). tools/lah_harness.py replaces only the display-title checkpoint with exact title-band matches of visually read retained frames (tools/lah_header_templates.json). Each DMD reading in diagnostic_snapshots was read by a curator from the retained 128x32 frame whose pixel digest is recorded beside it.

captive-lamps.note: The game start repeats the trough-serve run's steps; then, with the ball in play, each stimulus closes for 60 ms and the run waits 4 s. Lamp 32 never changed state in the whole run, attract mode included. Lamp state changes per stimulus (lamp 31 count; every lamp that changed): Captive: close 41 (left return lane): 31 changed 17 times; 6, 7, 8, 9, 19, 31, 40, 52, 57, 58, 59; Captive: close 42 (right return lane): 31 changed 16 times; 9, 31, 40, 57; Captive: close 40 (left captive target): 31 changed 4 times; 9, 31, 57; Captive: close 56 (right captive target): 31 changed 4 times; 9, 31, 57; Captive: close 39 (left captive rollover): 31 changed 6 times; 9, 31, 57; Captive: close 55 (right captive rollover): 31 changed 8 times; 9, 31, 57. Output 23 (game on) came on once, at 29.18 s, after the run set the shooter-lane switch 16 at 28.74 s, and stayed on.

trough-serve.note: Transitions exclude the outputs the attract and game-start lamp shows drive by themselves (9, 10, 11, 23 and 25-32). Neither crane limit switch (60, 61) was ever closed: the crane motor (14) came on during power-up, dropped 0.67 s after the Start press for 68 ms, and ran again until 0.85 s after the ball left the shooter lane (14 levels by host time: on at 5.81 s, off at 17.00 s, on at 17.07 s, off at 36.38 s). The auto-launch coil (3) fired 0.16 s after the launch trigger (8) closed.
